title: MID that runs past the end returns the characters there are

source.quote: The position of the first character you want to extract. Positions start at 1.
If the num_chars argument is larger than the number of characters available, the function returns the maximum characters available and doesn't raise an error.
source.supports: the rule documented for LEFT, applied to MID by analogy

derivation: Starting at position 4 ("d") only 2 characters remain: "de". The MID page does not say what happens when fewer characters remain than are asked for; LEFT documents that it returns what is available.
alternative: If MID raised an error when the count runs past the end, the query would fail. Neither page documents that.
